info.name: Campus Shoes - Super Admin
info.description: Every super-admin/* endpoint: users (+ addresses + order history), user mappings, reports, banners, dynamic config, rewards catalogue browsing, distributor returns/transfers (admin-wide views), support, and CMS (pages/FAQs/announcements/banners/app-versions + change history). All routes are SUPERADMIN-role-gated and @NoCache(). CMS/Banners/Support/Dynamic-Config/User-Mappings use GET/POST only (no PATCH/DELETE) except User Mappings' PATCH :id which predates that convention.
